$description: Semantic color — dark mode. Light and dark files must define identical token paths (enforced by validate).

default.$description: Page / app background. The canvas everything sits on.

raised.$description: Cards, menus, dialogs — any surface lifted above the page.

sunken.$description: Recessed areas: wells, code blocks, table headers.

default.$description: Content Primary: reading text, headings and icons.

subtle.$description: Content Secondary: helper text, metadata, captions.

disabled.$description: Text of disabled controls. Exempt from contrast rules (WCAG 1.4.3).

tertiary.$description: Content Tertiary: decorative or redundant text only. Never for essential, informational or interactive text. Not contrast-checked.

default.$description: Default outline for inputs and cards.

strong.$description: High-emphasis outline: hovered inputs, selected cards.

focus.$description: Keyboard focus ring. Must stay visible against every surface.

background.$description: Solid fill for primary elements. The brand’s main call to action. Use once per view for the most important action.

foreground.$description: Text and icons placed on color.primary.background.

text.$description: primary colored text or icon on a neutral surface (links, status labels).

subtle.$description: Tinted low-emphasis primary background (alerts, selected rows, soft chips).

background.$description: Solid fill for secondary elements. Brand accent for secondary emphasis. Never competes with primary.

foreground.$description: Text and icons placed on color.secondary.background.

text.$description: secondary colored text or icon on a neutral surface (links, status labels).

subtle.$description: Tinted low-emphasis secondary background (alerts, selected rows, soft chips).

background.$description: Solid fill for danger elements. Destructive actions and errors.

foreground.$description: Text and icons placed on color.danger.background.

text.$description: danger colored text or icon on a neutral surface (links, status labels).

subtle.$description: Tinted low-emphasis danger background (alerts, selected rows, soft chips).

background.$description: Solid fill for warning elements. Caution: something needs attention but is not broken.

foreground.$description: Text and icons placed on color.warning.background.

text.$description: warning colored text or icon on a neutral surface (links, status labels).

subtle.$description: Tinted low-emphasis warning background (alerts, selected rows, soft chips).

background.$description: Solid fill for success elements. Positive confirmation and completed states.

foreground.$description: Text and icons placed on color.success.background.

text.$description: success colored text or icon on a neutral surface (links, status labels).

subtle.$description: Tinted low-emphasis success background (alerts, selected rows, soft chips).

background.$description: Solid fill for info elements. Neutral, informative messages.

foreground.$description: Text and icons placed on color.info.background.

text.$description: info colored text or icon on a neutral surface (links, status labels).

subtle.$description: Tinted low-emphasis info background (alerts, selected rows, soft chips).
